news.body:
## The transfer is done
- SBI sent the wire on Thursday evening, five days early.
The SWIFT copy and the debit advice came to you with it. Marie Rose asked for proof of transfer when she extended the deadline, and that is what she meant, so sending it today closes the thread rather than leaving it open over the weekend.
## Today is the last working day before Sunday
- The letter from Jishnu is still the slow part.
Ascentium wrote to him on Monday with you in copy and nothing has gone back since. Of the documents she asked for it is the only one you cannot produce yourself, and the KITAS closure is dated Sunday.
- Harver has been late since the 16th.
Kraft Heinz cannot see your results until it is submitted. It is the one thing on the board nobody else is waiting on, which is exactly why it keeps slipping.
## Club 8 is Marie’s to answer now
- You asked her on Thursday about checking in directly on 3 January.
It has been the longest-standing late item on the board and there is nothing left on your side of it.
